description: This file defines the APIs, structures, and macros for the USB host support layer in the Zephyr project, including context management, class data, and initialization functions.

methods.name: usbh_init
methods.description: Initializes the USB host support context.

methods.name: usbh_enable
methods.description: Enables the USB host support and class instances.

methods.name: usbh_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the USB host support.
